description: The planned workout linked to one recorded activity, if any: workoutName, sport and steps, each with intensity, durationType/durationValue (metres for DISTANCE) and a target (e.g. targetType SPEED with targetValueLow/High in m/s). An activity started from one of Garmin's daily suggested workouts may carry only a workoutPhrase (e.g. EASY_WEEK_LOAD_BASE); an empty result means no workout was linked. This is the plan; for how each rep actually went use get_activity_analysis (laps). Get the ID from search_activities.
name: get_activity_workouts
title: Activity workouts
